name: form-message
title: FormMessage
description: Reusable TanStack Form-aware validation message surface with alert semantics and source-owned styling hooks.

meta.customization: Style generated messages through ui-form-message, data-invalid, data-touched, data-validating, and neutral data-slot hooks.
meta.api: FormMessage exports FormMessage and FormMessageProps. It accepts children, explicit errors, a TanStack field, or a TanStack form and formats validation errors through the shared formatFieldError helper. forceMount keeps the message node in the DOM for layout-stable custom compositions.
meta.accessibility: When invalid message content is present, FormMessage renders role=alert with aria-live=polite. Empty messages do not render unless forceMount is set, avoiding empty live regions.
meta.state: TanStack Form owns field and form error state. FormMessage only reads errors, touched, and validating metadata and mirrors those values through data attributes.
meta.ssr: Uses only props and Solid rendering; no browser globals are read, and forceMount allows deterministic layout where needed.
meta.limitations: FormMessage does not create label/control relationships by itself. Use TanStackField or Keystone Core form-control helpers for aria-describedby wiring on concrete controls.

parity.tanstackForm: First-class TanStack Form parity: reads field or form errors, supports explicit error overrides, and keeps validation lifecycle state app-owned.
parity.baseUi: Base UI-style field message semantics are represented through alert/live-region behavior while Core remains the owner of intrinsic control relationships.
parity.kobalte: Solid parity is a small composable message primitive with explicit props rather than hidden context requirements.
parity.shadcn: Source-owned message ergonomics match copy-paste UI conventions with stable class and data-slot hooks.
